component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.records.holds
component.documentation: A legal hold's guard, beyond the platform's. The platform takes Remove away from a person on a document under a legal hold, so their deletion and trash are refused, and the repository refuses the removal of a held document or of a folder holding one, and of its main file. It lets an administrator put a held document in the trash, which is a property, and anyone put a folder holding one there, and change a held document's attachments. This listener, synchronous, refuses, for a document under a legal hold and whoever asks: putting it, or a folder holding it, in the trash or deleting it; and a change to its main file or its attachments. Each refusal is a 409 with the code "held" and a sentence a person can act on, and nothing of the request is written. Its other properties stay editable, as the platform keeps them. Whom the platform lets delete what it keeps (its record cleaners) pass, as they pass the platform's guard.
